messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to buy apples, rice, and 12 cans of bottled water at Walmart near San Jose. They want product info and stock status. We need to call the function walmart_purchase with location "San Jose" or "San Jose, CA" and product_list ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"]. For bottled water, they want 12 cans. The function signature includes optional pack_size array. For each product, we can specify pack_size. For apples and rice, maybe default. For bottled water, pack_size 12. But pack_size array length should equal product_list length. So we need to provide pack_size array of same length: [undefined, undefined, 12] or maybe null? The function signature says pack_size?: number[]. So we can provide pack_size: [undefined, undefined, 12] but that might not be accepted. We could provide pack_size: [1, 1, 12] but apples and rice pack size maybe 1? But the function expects pack_size array length equal to product_list. If not specified, default is not use it if not specified. So we can just omit pack_size entirely. But we need to indicate quantity for bottled water. The function signature doesn't include quantity per item, only pack_size. But pack_size might represent quantity? The description: "Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified." So pack_size likely indicates quantity per pack. For bottled water, pack_size 12 means 12 cans. For apples and rice, maybe pack_size 1. So we can provide pack_size: [1, 1, 12]. That matches length 3. That seems fine.

Thus call function:

{
  loc: "San Jose",
  product_list: ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"],
  pack_size: [1, 1, 12]
}

We then wait for function result.
